hints.title: Decoupled Resource Requirements
hints.text: Energy and experience requirements are completely independent and can be computed separately.

hints.title: Total Energy Consumption
hints.text: Each opponent consumes a fixed energy amount, so total energy needed is sum(energy) + 1.

hints.title: Greedy Experience Deficit
hints.text: Simulate opponents in order. Whenever experience is at or below opponent experience, train immediately to opponent experience + 1.

hints.title: Simulation and Deficit Accumulation Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minNumberOfHours(self, initialEnergy: int, initialExperience: int, energy: list[int], experience: list[int]) -> int:
        req_energy = max(0, sum(energy) + 1 - initialEnergy)
        cur_exp = initialExperience
        req_exp = 0
        for e in experience:
            if cur_exp <= e:
                needed = e + 1 - cur_exp
                req_exp += needed
                cur_exp += needed
            cur_exp += e
        return req_energy + req_exp
```

complexity.notes: Single linear pass through opponent stats.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Binary search on training hours is overkill when closed greedy simulation runs in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decouples energy sum from experience progression.
